verdict.rationale: Supabase doesn't ship a first-party in-dashboard AI agent; instead it exposes an MCP server so external AI assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude) can query/act on a project on the user's behalf. This delegation works (live but auth-gated MCP endpoint, documented and hands-on verified) but real-world reports show it operates with elevated service_role access bypassing RLS and had a prompt-injection exploit, requiring mitigations.
